slides.sub: Two of them open by 7:30 AM on Sunday.

slides.title: Turning Point
slides.body: Breakfast, brunch and lunch, with seasonal specials. You can join the waitlist online before you head over.

slides.title: Vicki's Diner
slides.body: A classic diner on East Broad Street. The menu has pancakes, French toast and breakfast sandwiches.

slides.title: Addams Tavern
slides.body: A New American spot with wood-fired dishes and vaulted ceilings. Its brunch menu has carrot cake pancakes.

slides.title: Your Westfield brunch map
slides.tip: Touring on a weekend? Grab brunch first, then see the streets on a Sunday morning.
